ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 65% high-intensity white/light-grey pixels localized in the interior lobes and 35% low-intensity black pixels defining the margins, leading edges, and peduncle interface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Broad contiguous white geometric regions in the center of both lobes. trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 55 degrees at the vertex, dividing the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge characterized by high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks and valleys (serrations) extending from the median notch to the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature fitted to the trailing edges of both lobes, tapering to acute, narrow points at the distal extremities.

other_distinctive_markers: A unique arrangement of four distinct dark focal spots in the upper-distal quadrant of the right lobe, forming a recognizable geometric constellation against the white background.
